title: Sakina Itoo meets protesting doctors at GMC Srinagar, assures examination of demands

ai.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Health Minister Sakina Itoo met protesting doctors at GMC Srinagar, assuring examination of their demands for stipend hikes, parity with other states, and maternity leave benefits. The protest, now in its fifth consecutive day at GMC Srinagar and sixth at GMC Jammu, has spread to district hospitals across the state.

facts.claim: Sakina Itoo met protesting postgraduate and senior resident doctors at GMC Srinagar
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 23: Jammu and Kashmir Health and Medical Education Minister Sakina Itoo on Monday met protesting postgraduate (PG) and senior resident doctors at Government Medical College (GMC) Srinagar and assured them that their demands would be examined and all possible assistance extended to address their concerns.

facts.claim: The protest entered its fifth consecutive day at GMC Srinagar and sixth day at GMC Jammu
facts.quote: The protest entered its fifth consecutive day at GMC Srinagar and sixth day at GMC Jammu on Monday, with doctors from additional medical institutions and district hospitals joining the agitation.

facts.claim: Doctors are demanding a substantial hike in stipends, parity with their counterparts in other States and Union Territories and maternity leave benefits
facts.quote: The protesting doctors are demanding a substantial hike in stipends, parity with their counterparts in other States and Union Territories and maternity leave benefits.

facts.claim: The minister reiterated that their concerns would be examined and the government would extend all possible assistance in addressing their demands
facts.quote: During the interaction, Itoo was apprised of the issues confronting the doctors, particularly the disparity in stipends compared to resident doctors elsewhere in the country and the need for appropriate maternity leave provisions. The minister reiterated that their concerns would be examined and the government would extend all possible assistance in addressing their demands.

facts.claim: The agitation has spread beyond medical colleges to several district hospitals across Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: Meanwhile, the agitation gained further momentum on Monday, with doctors at several district hospitals announcing peaceful protests in support of the movement.

ai.background_note: The protest involves doctors demanding stipend hikes, parity with other states, and maternity leave benefits, spreading to district hospitals across Jammu and Kashmir.
